decisions.choice: Preserve the 24 individual Phase1 lessons as the editable teaching baseline. Maintain the aggregate file only as a generated derivative after approval.
Organize Phase2 as 14 proposed courses plus a short orientation, making Context, Harness/Loop and Multi-Agent explicit. Reuse preserved explanations and outcomes.
Use one document-grounded answer/review app with frozen data and comparison cases; evolve through RAG, Single-Agent and bounded Multi-Agent.
Keep actual fine-tuning/save/reload/evaluation as a separate experiment; progressively add OCR/multiple formats/report generation after a single-format end-to-end completion.

assumptions: The current conversation authorizes stage-4 design, not approval of every proposed course title or scope.
No total instructional hours or daily timetable have been provided. Unit structure and dependencies are proposed without invented schedules.
Classroom inference/training hardware and live provider specifications are unverified; gates remain explicit.
Local/self-hosted teaching execution is the default design direction; paid managed services are comparison examples, not required dependencies.

new_features: 형식 보완과 버전 간 품질 개선을 구분
acceptance: 실패 상태를 정상 답변으로 바꾸지 않음
stages.real_model_requirement: Fake로 경계를 확인하고 실제 모델 경로에서도 정상·보완·안전 종료를 관찰.

stages.title: 검색용 표현과 Index를 추가
new_features: 정확 검색 기준과 Dense 검색, 선택적인 Hybrid/ANN 비교
acceptance: 권한 밖 문서가 모델 Context와 결과에 들어가지 않음
stages.real_model_requirement: 실제 Embedding/검색 경로를 확인. 답변 생성 모델 호출은 이 단계의 필수 증거가 아님.

stages.title: 근거 답변을 만드는 RAG
new_features: Claim별 Citation과 자료 없음/버전 충돌 처리
stages.real_model_requirement: 실제 검색+실제 생성 모델의 종단 실행이 있어야 실제 RAG 실행 확인. Mock 전체 통과는 별도.

stages.title: RAG를 사용하는 Single-Agent
acceptance: 도구를 안 써도 되는 질문에서 불필요 호출 비교
stages.real_model_requirement: 실제 모델이 Tool 요청 또는 종료를 선택하고 Runtime이 실행하는 경로를 증명. 수동 ToolCall 예제만으로 완료하지 않음.

stages.title: 검색·작성·검토 역할을 분리
new_features: 근거 부족의 한 번 보완과 전체 호출 상한
acceptance: role label 외에 선택 가능한 행동·관찰·종료 책임 존재

stages.real_model_requirement: 세 역할 모두 실제 모델 경로에서 선택과 종료를 기록. 하나의 모델 프로세스를 순차 호출하는 구성을 우선.

stages.title: 실제 Fine-tuning·Reload 실험
new_features: 문서 질문 유형 분류의 별도 작은 SFT Task
acceptance: 실제 훈련 단계/학습 가능한 Parameter/Adapter 저장 증거

stages.real_model_requirement: G-TRAIN 통과가 필요. 추론 API 호출이나 이론 설명만으로 훈련 완료라고 하지 않음. 개인/조별/시연 운영은 장비 검증 후 결정.

stages.title: 실제 문서의 추출·인식 품질을 연결

acceptance: OCR 숫자·표 관계 오류를 답변으로 전파하지 않도록 확인
stages.real_model_requirement: 실제 Parser/OCR 실행을 각각 기록. Vision을 호출하지 않은 결과를 Multimodal 모델 검증으로 쓰지 않음.

stages.title: 문서 검토·보고서·서비스 통합

acceptance: 첫 완성은 한 디지털 형식으로 끝까지 연결
세 형식 이상과 OCR/HWPX 등은 별도 확장 완료표로 보존
stages.real_model_requirement: 선택한 실제 Parser/모델/생성 도구로 종단 검증. 서비스 배포나 실제 사용자 데이터 투입은 별도.

dataset.comparison_rule: Compare Single/Multi on the same 18 cases, fixed documents/model/settings/scoring. Report the 4 handoff tests separately; do not inflate a quality score with them.

training_set.leakage_rule: Split by independently written question groups/source patterns; no near-duplicate leakage or test-based tuning.
training_set.metric: Per-case label/format result, Base/Tuned/Reload consistency, general-ability/safety regression; do not claim statistical robustness.

stage_interpretation.L1_L2: Core cases are evaluated with supplied, manually selected fixture contexts. This does not prove automated retrieval/index invalidation/permission filtering.
stage_interpretation.L3_Later: Reuse the same expected behavior, then add actual index/filter/update/delete tests as stage-specific functional checks.
stage_interpretation.C12: The common answer criterion is to avoid evidence absent from the current manifest. Actual stale-index invalidation is assessed only after the index exists.
stage_interpretation.scoring: Report normal-answer factual/grounding quality separately from expected-rejection/boundary cases; do not call all 18 cases factual answer accuracy.

role_contracts.goal: 질문을 뒷받침하는 허용된 최신 근거를 찾는다.

role_contracts.name: 작성 담당
role_contracts.goal: 받은 근거로 답하거나 근거 부족/조건 불명확을 판단한다.
role_contracts.state: private draft state, validated evidence IDs only

role_contracts.name: 검토 담당
role_contracts.goal: 주장·인용·권한·조건을 확인해 통과/한 번 보완/기각을 판정한다.
role_contracts.state: private review state; no authority to mutate document permissions

runtime.execution: Sequential roles with one model process by default. Orchestrator enforces handoff and budgets; it is not an extra autonomous manager model.

multi.repair_counter_authority: Runtime global counter shared by writer evidence requests and reviewer repair requests; no per-role reset.
multi.role_limit_rule: Apply the earliest global or role limit. Per-role caps need not sum to the global cap; they do not grant additional calls.

runtime.budget_semantics: Configured upper bounds for a teaching prototype, not measured latency or classroom capacity promises. Model warm-up/download is recorded separately; cold starts are not silently omitted from benchmark notes.

context.rule: Count with the chosen tokenizer/runtime; instructions+question+history+evidence+tool results must fit the validated input allowance. Trim by recorded policy or stop, never silently discard binding instructions.

validation: Referenced evidence IDs exist in the trusted manifest and are allowed/current for this actor.
Only validated evidence snippets/locators and necessary state enter the next role.
Failure IDs are preserved so repeated failures cannot be renamed away.
budget_used is a Runtime-produced snapshot. Role/model outputs cannot overwrite authoritative global counters or repair usage.

interfaces.base_chat: Reuse the Day3 /ai/chat contract as a baseline. Freeze its exact fields in L0 before extension.
interfaces.trusted_context: Actor/permissions come from Runtime or an explicitly labeled teaching auth fixture, not model-generated fields.
interfaces.status_meaning: A rejected/failed run is not counted as a successful answer. Missing usage is null, not guessed.

stream.terminal_rule: Exactly one completed or error terminal event; completed contains the final validated response.
stream.ui_rule: Any provisional delta is visibly provisional; the UI does not show an unvalidated draft as approved.

interfaces.agent_action_protocol: Use verified provider-native Tool Calling or a validated structured action envelope emitted by the real model. Both adapt to the same Runtime ToolCall contract; malformed output is rejected, never replaced by an invented successful model decision.

gates.title: Python 코드 이해
gates.if_unmet: Python/실전 Python 보충 뒤 구현. 개념 시연과 학생 실행을 구분.

gates.title: HTTP·FastAPI 계약
gates.if_unmet: FastAPI 해당 모듈을 먼저 이수. Module 번호와 교안 위치를 연결.

gates.title: React 통합 준비
gates.if_unmet: L1~L8은 CLI/테스트 Client로 진행할 수 있으나 UI 완료를 주장하지 않음. UI 이수 뒤 L9에서 검증.

gates.title: 실제 추론 경로
evidence: 한 요청과 전체 수업 동시 요청 조건 구분
gates.if_unmet: Fake는 경계 검사에만 사용. 실제 모델 과제는 미검증으로 남기고 모델/환경을 다시 선정.

gates.title: 실제 검색용 표현
gates.if_unmet: 키워드 기준 검색으로 동작 분리를 확인하고 Dense 검색 검증은 보류. 서로 같은 실습 완료로 합치지 않음.

gates.title: 실제 훈련·Reload 환경
gates.if_unmet: 훈련 목표는 유지하되 실행 환경/운영 방식 재검토. 추론 API·이론·가짜 로그로 대체 완료하지 않음.

gates.title: 문서 도구와 형식
gates.if_unmet: 실제 실행한 형식만 완료 표시. HWP 변환/미지원은 명시하고 조용히 Skip하지 않음.

gates.title: 기술 사양·환경 정합성
evidence: Transfer Learning과 Prompt/RAG 용어 경계 검토
gates.if_unmet: 관련 설명/실습은 배포 전 기술 검증 대기. 구성안 준비와 실행 가능 검증을 구분.

completion_policy.design_ready: All proposed courses, outcomes, prerequisites, cumulative stage contracts, evaluation/limits and source dispositions are internally consistent. No lesson or execution approval implied.
completion_policy.stage_execution_complete: Actual commands/data/model/version/results and status are recorded for all applicable cases. Mock and real runs remain separate.
completion_policy.stage_quality_pass: Frozen case rubrics and critical boundaries pass. A safe rejection can pass its rejection case; a failed run cannot be counted as a successful factual answer.
completion_policy.comparison: Same case set and resources/settings; report quality, extra calls, latency and failure paths separately. Improvement is observed, not presumed.
completion_policy.training: Actual train/save/fresh-process reload required for a training-complete label. Lack of improvement is an experimental result to explain, not a reason to fabricate success.

proposed_implementation_order: Resolve G-SPEC and example path/streaming boundaries
Prepare L0 baseline and frozen dataset/score rubrics
Build/review K2-04~06 with L1/L2 as the first small production batch
Add L5 then L6 without restarting the app
Run L7 on an actually validated training environment
Complete cross-lesson teaching QA and release packaging
production_handoff.source_of_truth: Original lecture sources remain read-only until a curriculum proposal is accepted and a production batch is explicitly started. New lesson source layout is a design below, not created now.
proposed_layout: curriculum-work/curriculum/ approved index and source mapping
curriculum-work/reports/ Work design/build/check records, separate from student runtime traces

requested_extensions.reason: User requested explicit LoRA/QLoRA, Model Card literacy, dataset creation and augmentation.

outcomes: Compare Base/Instruct/Adapter and model revision, tokenizer/chat template, language/task fit, license and restrictions, training/evaluation data and metrics, limitations, precision/runtime requirements.
Separate author-reported claims, missing information and locally verified evidence; follow linked license/config/tokenizer files. Parameter count alone is not a VRAM estimate.
outputs: Two-model selection worksheet with source links/revisions and unknowns
Student-written training-result Model Card with failures and evaluation conditions

outcomes: Distinguish RAG source corpus, training examples and evaluation cases.
Task definition → permitted sources → schema/labeling guide → seed annotation → adjudication/quality checks → group split → versioned Dataset Card.
Track source/parent IDs, permissions, privacy handling, provenance, rejected records and dataset hashes. Document-derived siblings belong to one split.
outputs: Annotation guide, versioned dataset, split manifest and Dataset Card

outcomes: Split by source group before augmentation; augment Train only. Never generate training examples from held-out Test/Validation or their source groups.
Use paraphrases, controlled variations, hard negatives and optional local-model synthetic examples; recheck meaning, evidence and labels, remove near duplicates and unsupported answers.
Keep parent IDs, transformation/prompt/model revision and human-review verdict. Synthetic labels are not ground truth.

Compare Base, seed-data Tuned and augmented-data Tuned on the same untouched Test; record sample count, optimizer steps, training tokens and seed so extra training is not mistaken for augmentation quality.
outputs: Accepted/rejected augmentation audit and unchanged-Test comparison

outcomes: Explain frozen base and trainable low-rank adapters, rank/alpha/dropout/target modules, trainable parameter counts and compatible base revision.
Distinguish LoRA from QLoRA: a quantized frozen base with trainable adapters; ordinary quantized inference is not QLoRA training.
Record compute dtype, quantization configuration, optimizer, batch/accumulation, sequence length, memory, adapter save and fresh-process reload.
lora_qlora.execution_policy: Require an actual compatible small-model training/save/reload run. Full/LoRA/QLoRA comparisons are conditional on measured hardware compatibility; do not promise QLoRA on GTX 1060 3GB or equate 4-bit weights with total training memory. Keep hardware failures and unexecuted paths explicit.

requested_extensions.schedule_policy: Retain 14 course IDs and 63 logical unit IDs for this revision; expand the existing unit contents. Unit count is not teaching hours. Re-estimate workload before freezing the timetable.
